# git: alias: add git fixup or git author

Add an alias that re-stamps the last commit with the identity of the current repository:

```
$ git commit --amend --no-edit --allow-empty --author="$(git whoami)"
```

The case is a commit made under the wrong `user.name`/`user.email` — common when switching between personal, OctoLab and client identities ([[DOT-422]]) — where the fix is to amend the author only, keeping message and content. `git whoami` ([[DOT-89]]) supplies the `Name <email>` string.
